installCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then yarn --cwd frontend install --frozen-lockfile; else yarn install --frozen-lockfile; fi
buildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then yarn --cwd frontend build && mkdir -p build && cp -R frontend/build/. build/; else yarn build; fi && mkdir -p build/pass && cp -R checkin-kit/. build/pass/ && rm -f build/pass/vercel.json build/pass/README.md
